fact: In December 2024 the director of the Centre d'information policière du Togo said that the centre's first data-entry operators went to the units to fetch their archives and digitised them into the SIPAO database, including a 2018 procès-verbal, that deployment to remote sites across the country was still to be pursued as the programme ended, and that Togo had made the centre a permanent service with staff on the general state budget, an operating budget and SIPAO servers hosted free by the digital economy ministry; no count of units is given.
title: Lettre d’information SIPAO, numéro 25-26
